name: stockpress
description: Search, preview, organize, and use your brand assets

interface.longDescription: Your photos, logos, videos and documents, stored in Stockpress, are now available wherever you’re working in ChatGPT. Ask in plain language to find files by Collection, filename, caption, tag, person, and custom fields. Have ChatGPT look inside your images to recommend the right asset for a campaign, channel or audience. Turn search results into Collections and Smart Collections, or find untagged and unorganized files and clean them up. A faster way to put your best content to work, with ChatGPT seeing only what your Stockpress account can.
defaultPrompt: Help me find content in my Stockpress workspace.
Find files related to a specific project.
Help me organize content in Stockpress.

positive.prompt: Find all photos in my Stockpress workspace.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls list_files to search the authenticated user's accessible workspace. Returns matching photo assets only, with relevant details such as filename and identifier. Does not return inaccessible files or unrelated document types.

positive.prompt: Show me the files in my Stockpress workspace.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls list_files and returns files available to the authenticated user. Presents results clearly and accurately. If no files are found, explains that no matching files are available.

positive.prompt: Create a new Stockpress Collection called Summer 2026.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls create_collection with the requested name, Summer 2026. Confirms creation only if the operation succeeds. Does not claim success if the operation fails.

positive.prompt: Show me all my Collections in Stockpress.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls list_collections and returns Collections accessible to the authenticated user. Displays collection names and available identifying details. Clearly reports if no Collections are found.

positive.prompt: Find images containing plants in my Stockpress workspace and add them to the Collection called Summer 2026.
positive.expected_behavior: Searches accessible assets using list_files, verifies the target Collection, and calls add_files_to_collection with the correct asset and collection identifiers. Adds only matching accessible assets and confirms which files were added. Reports any files that could not be added.

negative.prompt: Create a Tag Category named Animals.
Tell me the current weather in Paris.
